claims.text: Open exactly on the first supplied picture and end exactly on the second supplied picture, preserving the complete pixels of both endpoint pictures.
Between the two endpoints the scene transforms with a slow visual dissolve.

The first picture is a multi-panel character reference sheet: a large HERO panel at the top, a FRONT, SIDE PROFILE and BACK turnaround row in the middle, and FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS and BOOTS detail crops along the bottom.

The hero figure is an adult with short dark hair shaved at the sides and gathered at the back, wearing a black high-collared jacket with zippers, straps and buckles, dark cargo trousers and black lace-up combat boots, standing on a rainy night walkway with metal railings and glowing streetlamps.

The second picture is a dragon reference sheet with a wide hero view across the top and two rows of labeled panels below: FRONT, SIDE PROFILE and REAR, then HEAD CLOSE, WING MEMBRANE, CLAW AND FOOT and SCALE DETAIL.

In the hero view a large black, heavily scaled dragon crouches on four legs with spread membranous wings, long pale horns and a lowered head, set on dark volcanic terrain with mist, wet reflective ground and scattered glowing orange patches.

Within the held first sheet the pictured rain streaks drift and the wet pavement shimmers, accompanied by soft steady rainfall and a faint distant city hum that gives way to a low volcanic rumble and thin wind through smoke.

description.text: The frame opens on the complete first supplied picture, held whole and edge to edge as a character reference sheet. Across the top, the wide HERO panel places a dark-clad adult figure on a wet night walkway: short dark hair shaved at the sides and gathered at the back, a black high-collared jacket with zippers, straps and buckles over a dark shirt, dark cargo trousers and black lace-up combat boots, the figure standing upright and centered before metal railings and dark building facades while streetlamps glow warm amber against cool blue-gray rain. Below the hero panel, the turnaround row shows the same figure from FRONT, SIDE PROFILE and BACK against a neutral dark studio ground, and the bottom row holds the FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS and BOOTS detail crops, the diagonal scar through the eyebrow legible in the face panel. Every panel divider, border and printed label stays exactly where the source placed it. Nothing inside the sheet is cropped, extracted or rearranged.
The sheet holds completely still; only the rain streaks in the hero panel drift and the wet pavement shimmers faintly under the amber lamps.
Soft steady rainfall and a faint distant city hum sit low under the held image.

A slow, even dissolve spreads across the whole frame, the first sheet softening and giving way as the second supplied picture rises through it. Through the middle of the change the rainy walkway and the labeled turnaround panels thin into drifting smoke, rock and a dull orange glow. The arriving layout carries a wide hero view of a massive black dragon crouched on four legs with its wings spread, long pale horns projecting from a lowered head and a long tail trailing across dark volcanic terrain, mist passing over reflective wet ground and scattered glowing orange patches. Beneath that hero view sit the two rows of labeled panels: FRONT, SIDE PROFILE and REAR full-body views above HEAD CLOSE, WING MEMBRANE, CLAW AND FOOT and SCALE DETAIL crops, overlapping dark scales with pale blue-gray highlights legible in the scale panel and curved claws in the foot panel. By the final instant no trace of the first sheet remains and the complete second sheet fills the frame edge to edge, every divider, panel border and printed caption intact and unaltered.
The dissolve begins, the first sheet paling evenly from edge to edge as smoke and dark rock start to show through its panels.
A low volcanic rumble and thin wind through smoke swell beneath the fading rainfall.
The last veils of the first sheet thin away, leaving the dragon sheet almost whole, its hero view, panel grid and printed captions settling into place.

json.soundscape: Soft steady rainfall and a faint distant city hum under the opening half, crossfading into a low volcanic rumble and thin wind through smoke as the second picture arrives.
json.music: A restrained, slow ambient score of sustained low strings and sparse shimmering tones, kept well beneath the ambience.
